# cb:b052 · dag-field-presence

> Field presence on a DAG node is determined by structural type; aggregations and inferences require deps, prescriptions require deps or a stipulation artifact, and contract fields are prescription-only

**Type:** prescription (contract-grade) · **Kind:** domain-rule · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `field-presence`
**Created:** 2026-06-10

## Invariants

- Aggregations cannot have empty deps
- Inferences cannot have empty deps
- Active prescriptions carry deps or a stipulation artifact
- Contract fields (rules, invariants) are prescription-only
- Fields are emitted in a stable schema-defined order
- Fields absent in the source JSON are not emitted on round-trip (presence tracked via _keys)
- tags defaults to empty list when absent from source

## Rules

```json
{
  "given": "A node of any type",
  "scenario": "Shared fields are always valid",
  "then": "id, type, kind, domain, tags, claim, subjects, status, created are all valid fields",
  "when": "Shared fields are accessed"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type: attestation",
  "scenario": "Attestation-specific fields",
  "then": "artifact (required) and evidence (dated, append-only) are valid; deps, materialized, rules, invariants are not meaningful",
  "when": "Type-specific fields are considered"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type: aggregation",
  "scenario": "Aggregation requires deps",
  "then": "The node must have a non-empty deps array - an aggregation by definition composes multiple deps",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type: inference",
  "scenario": "Inference requires deps",
  "then": "The node must have a non-empty deps array - a conclusion traces its grounding even when its claim exceeds it",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type: prescription",
  "scenario": "Prescription grounds in deps or stipulation",
  "then": "The node must have non-empty deps or a stipulation artifact (plan:/user:/session:/document:) - adoption is grounded in beliefs or in the record of the adoption event",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
```
